purpose: Additive current-scene material audition questions; unchanged historical retrieval fixtures.

questions.query: Can I change density, viscosity or reactions in the actual current Workbench scene and what does Revert undo?
facts: The Draft/HOLD implementation extends the existing Materials Lab and applies profiles in the existing World at its native-owner boundary.
Density is directional cell exchange; viscosity is limited to active generic consumers, and reaction thresholds preserve inclusive roll semantics.
Revert restores configuration, not moved, reacted or consumed cells.
Named profiles are saved separately; authored scene saves do not retain the trial and exact physical saves refuse nondefault profiles.
Unsupported solver assignments, invalid values, stale revisions, retired Worlds and sessions are refused.
